answer: An identity must show a conference-attendance streak: registrations, badges, and talks attended across years, with the organizers confirming the record. To wander a conference hall and be seen takes presence, and the record shows it. A juniper grows slowly in thin soil, and an attendance streak grows the same way, one conference at a time. An echo of a farm's attendance is hollow: their badges are all from one event, all last month, all with no talks attended, and the organizers' own lists expose the pattern.
